fields.name: template
fields.label: Template
fields.description: Template name, e.g. article-type. Must match an entry in the site configuration (custom.templates).

fields.name: json-ld
fields.label: JSON-LD (Structured Data)
fields.description: Optional. Site-wide JSON-LD (e.g. the WebSite schema) is authored once in the bulk metadata sheet (/content/midwives/metadata, row /** with a json-ld column); only fill this in for page-specific structured data, it replaces the site-wide value on this page. Rendered as a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag in the page head.
